text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I continue to train with Sakura Bakushin
O for her
next race. One day, some
good news comes
knocking on the door.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She was selected for "The Year's
Notable
Umamusume." I immediately go
looking for her to
share the news...

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: You're just amazing, Bakushin O!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
To have your name in a magazine with
that much
influence, only you could do
it! Speed really pays
off, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Heheh, I know, right?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Of course I, your very talented class

representative, would have your hearts
bursting
with emotion!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text: I wouldn't take it that far...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like she's having a good time
with her
classmates. I'll talk to her later...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! Hello there!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You've come at just the right time! I'm
currently
being swamped with
compliments!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Nothing less for someone as talented as
I! Don't
feel shy to join in on the fun!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Well, you see!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Wait, what was it again?!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
You got selected by a magazine for their
special
feature, "The Year's Notable
Umamusume"...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: No way!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
How splendid! Those media people
really have a
good eye for things!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: We just told you...

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
You know that's how she is. Trainer, we'll
leave
the rest to you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her classmates vanish just like that. I
think I've
got an idea of what her usual
days in the
classroom are like now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Looks like the world's catching up to my
Bakushin
speed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Please, allow me to see that magazine at
onc—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Where is everyone?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see! Then I must go looking for it
myself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain to Sakura Bakushin O that this
magazine
feature is why I came looking
for her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I see! Then let us depart for your office!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, her good mood doesn't last
very long...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Grrr!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: What. Is. This?! I invoke my title as class representative and object to this information!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The selection was based on the vote of a
few
well-renowned reporters. They were
singing
nothing but praise for Sakura
Bakushin O...
choice_data_list: They wrote some pretty great things, though.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No, no! You are forgetting a very
important thing!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Just why did they put my name in the "Sprint Division"?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It says here, "The People's Favorite Sprinter "... The media has lost their marbles! No, they've lost the whole pool!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Are you listening? I am not an
Umamusume to be
sorted into a little
category like "sprinter"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And you know why?! Because I'm class

representative!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Why must I be confined to a category so
small...
It's frustrating!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Let's definitely, definitely win the Classics this year! That'll show them!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...It looks like the reporters' fervent
praise only
makes Sakura Bakushin O
more competitive.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I want nothing more than for her to win
the
Classics, but even if she moves away
from sprints,
it wouldn't do much to help
matters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...I've got to convince Sakura Bakushin O
to
change her mind, no matter the cost!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Tell me, what is it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hm? What do you mean?
choice_data_list: Why don't we look at the 'Spring Stakes' results?
Want to look at the 'Spring Stakes' results?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O is an Umamusume
who's
confident she'll win any race she
sets her mind to.
I find that amazing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she still has a ways to go.
Depending on
the results of the Spring
Stakes, we may have to
review our
training methods.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It might mean concentrating on running
shorter
distances this year to work on
that exceptional
speed of hers. Or so I
explain...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
So you mean there's a possibility I can't
run in the
Classics this year?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't that mean careening off of the
Bakushin
Road?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Wh-whoa! I'm not really sure what you
mean,
but—
choice_data_list: All of this is for the future Arima Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You sounded kind of cool there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...I think I've gotten the hang of
handling, or
should I say, guiding her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I understand... Let's make a promise! I
trust you to
keep it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If I happen to lose, then I will focus on
sprint
training.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
But only if it'll bring me closer to my
future goals!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: ...It will bring her closer to her future, that's for sure. In any case, this is one way of convincing her to stick with sprint training.
